evidence.observation: Pressure 3.014 Torr at growth start, same as the ramp baseline (~3.00)
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.251 Torr (about +0.06 Torr every 120 s) and shows no sign of levelling off
Ar flow is steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by a change in flow
Temperature is holding at 750 °C with normal heater power, so the thermal side looks normal
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so I can't check the atmosphere for air getting in

args.missing_evidence: I need something that tells air getting in apart from gas being held back. Options: an O2 or residual-gas reading at the exhaust, a leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with the flow isolated, or a check of the exhaust line and pump for a restriction.
